name: A real tracked link types on over a faint grid
looks: On a near-black, finely gridded field, a small mono caption names what is being counted today. Below it a long real URL with UTM parameters types on in mono, a thin accent cursor blinking at its end, as a soft horizontal light streak drifts past on the right.
build: terminal-type-on for the URL's per-character reveal; grain-vignette's grid texture sits static beneath it; the light streak is a blurred gradient shape drifting linearly across the right third, independent of the typing.
sound: A light mechanical key tick per character, with a low ambient hum under the streak.
prompt: Open on proof of real detail: a long, real-looking tracked URL with query parameters types on in mono over a faint technical grid, a small caption above naming what it represents, so the first thing proven is precision, not a slogan.
